title: AgenticJevNav: Agentic Object Search and Navigation via Event-Driven Verification
abstract: arXiv:2611.19912v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Agentic navigation must maintain goals and adapt actions from incomplete evidence despite execution failures and delayed inference. We present AgenticJevNav, which links goal-directed planning, evidence memory, event-triggered verification, and bounded execution. The Agent plans from RGB, odometry, memory, and feedback, retaining goal ownership while authorizing a bounded action set. Jev reviews structured evidence after blocked/failed execution or two consecutive low-progress segments. Version, freshness, and once-only checks govern decision application. A single executor and independent RGB reflex constrain motion. Goal revisions revoke obsolete requests and actions before replanning. Across six simulated task families, AgenticJevNav achieves 73.33% SR over 60 trials, 21.67 percentage points above the next-best Agent-only aggregate control under differing historical protocols. A real-world GENISOM L1 quadruped deployment achieves 70.

translated_title: AgenticJevNav：基于事件驱动验证的智能体目标搜索与导航
translated_abstract: 智能体导航需要在执行失败和推理延迟的情况下，基于不完整的证据维持目标并自适应调整行动。我们提出了AgenticJevNav，它将目标导向规划、证据记忆、事件触发验证和有界执行有机结合起来。智能体基于RGB图像、里程计、记忆和反馈进行规划，在授权有限动作集的同时保持对目标的所有权。Jev机制在被阻塞/执行失败或连续两个低进度片段之后审查结构化证据。版本、新鲜度和一次性检查约束着决策的应用。单一执行器和独立的RGB反射机制共同约束运动。目标修订会在重新规划之前撤销过时的请求和动作。在六个模拟任务族中，AgenticJevNav在60次试验中实现了73.33%的成功率（SR），在不同历史协议下比次优的纯智能体聚合对照组高出21.67个百分点。在真实世界的GENISOM L1四足机器人部署中达到了70%（原文截断）。
tldr: 该论文提出AgenticJevNav框架，通过事件触发验证机制（Jev）将目标导向规划、证据记忆与有界执行相结合，使智能体在执行失败或进展停滞时自主审查证据并安全地修订目标，在六个模拟任务族上取得73.33%的成功率并经真实四足机器人验证。
en_tdlr: AgenticJevNav integrates goal-directed planning, evidence memory, and event-triggered verification (Jev) with bounded execution, enabling agents to autonomously review evidence and safely revise goals upon execution failures, achieving 73.33% success rate across six simulated task families and validated on a real quadruped robot.
